content: Sahpw me Kohieng Simion
Keriaun kileldi en sahpw wiawihong peneinei kan me kadaudok en Simion. Sahpwo lellahng sahpw me kohieng kadaudok en Suda.
E iangahki Peersepa, Sipa, Molada,
Asar, Sual, Pala, Esem,
Eldolad, Pedul, Orma,
Siklak, Ped Markapod, Asar Susa,
Ped Lapaod, oh Saruhen: koaros patpene me eisek siluh, iangahki kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene.
Pil mie Ain, Rimmon, Eder, oh Asan: koaros patpene me pahieu, iangahki kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene.
Pil iangahki kahnimw koaros me kapilpene kahnimw pwukat lellahng Paalad Peer (de Rama), me mi ni palieir. Ih sahpw wet me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Simion.
Pwehki sapwen Suda eh siksang uwen me re anahne, kahrehda ekis wasa nan sahpwo kohieng kadaudok en Simion.
Sahpw me Kohieng Sepulon
Kesiluhn kileldi en sahpw wiawihong peneinei kan me kadaudok en Sepulon. Sahpw me kohieng irail lellahng Sarid.
Irepen sahpwo tepisang mwo kolahng palikapi lel Mareal oh tang limwahn irepen Dappesed oh piletik me mi palimesehn Sokneam.
Ni pali teio en Sarid e tang kolahng palimesehn irepen Kislod Tapor, e ahpw inenlahng Daperad oh kohdahla Sapia.
E ahpw doulluhl sang wasao kolahng palimese ong Kad Eper oh Edkatin, e ahpw wet kolahng Nead ni ahl en Rimmon.
Ni paliepeng irepen sahpwo tang kolahng Annadon, oh ididi ni Wahun Iptahel.
E iangahki Kattad, Nahalal, Simron, Idala, oh Pedleem: kahnimw eisek riau, iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene.
Kahnimw pwukat iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me mihte nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Sepulon.
Sahpw me Kohieng Isakar
Kapahieun kileldi en sahpw wiawihong peneinei kan en kadaudok en Isakar.
Uwen sahpw wet pil iangahki Sesreel, Kesulod, Sunem,
Aparaim, Sion, Anaharad,
Rappid, Kision, Epes,
Remed, Engannim, Enadda oh Pedpasses.

Irepen sahpwo pil tang limwahn Tapor, Sahasuma, oh Ped Semes oh ididi ni Pillap Sordan. E iangahki kahnimw eisek weneu oh kisin kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene. Kahnimw pwukat iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me mi nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Isakar.
Kahnimw pwukat iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me mi nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Isakar.
Sahpw me Kohieng Aser
Kelimaun kileldi en sahpw wiawihong peneinei kan en kadaudok en Aser.
Uwen sahpw wet me iangahki Elkad, Ali, Peten, Aksap,
Allam Melek, Amad, oh Misal. Ni palikapi e lellahng Karmel oh Sihor Lipnad.
Ni eh wet kolahng palimese, irepen sahpw tang kolahng Peddakon, oh lel irepen Sepulon oh Wahun Iptahel kolahng paliepeng en Pedemek oh Neiel. E ahpw douluhlla kolahng Kapul ni paliepeng,
Epron, Rehop, Ammon oh Kana lellahng Saidon.
Irepen sahpwo ahpw uhd wetlahng Rama, oh lellahng kahnimw me kehl kehlail, me iei Dair; e ahpw wetlahng Osa oh ididi ni Sehd Mediderenien. E iangahki kahnimw pwukat: Mahalap, Aksip,
Umma, Apek oh Rehop: kahnimw rieisek riau iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene.
Kahnimw pwukat iangahki kisin kahnimw kan mihte nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Aser.
Sahpw me Kohieng Napdali
Keweneun kileldi en sahpw wiawihong peneinei kan en kadaudok en Napdali.
Irepen sahpw wet tepisang Elep kolahng tuhke ohk me mi Saanannim, oh kolahng Adaminekep oh Samnia, pil lellang Lakkum oh ididi ni Pillap Sordan.
Irepen sahpwo ahpw wet wasao kolahng Asnod Tapor ni palikapi, oh sang mwo ahpw tang kolahng Ukkok limwahn Sepulon ni palieir, Aser ni palikapi oh Pillap Sordan ni palimese.
Kahnimw kan me ahneki kehl kehlail iei Siddim, Ser, Amad, Rakkad, Kinnered,
Adama, Rama, Asor,
Kedes, Edrei, Enasor,
Wairon, Mikdalel, Orem, Pedanad, oh Ped Semes: kahnimw eisek duwau, iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me kapilirailpene.
Kahnimw pwukat iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me mihte nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Sepulon.
Sahpw me Kohieng Dan
Keisuhn kileldi en sahpw wiawihong peneinei kan en kadaudok en Dan.
Uwen sahpw wet me iangahki Sora, Estaol, Irsemes,
Saalpim, Aisalon, Idla,
Elon, Timna, Ekron,
Elteke, Kippedon, Paalad,
Sehud, Peneperak, Kadrimmon,
Masarkon oh Rakkon, iangahki sahpw me kapil Sopa.

Ahnsou me tohn Dan pwupwusang nan sapwarailo, re kohla Lais pwe re en mahweniong. Re ahpw kalowehdi, kemehla towe kan oh sapwenikihla. Re ahpw soandiong nan sahpwo oh wekidala eden sahpw wekidiong ni Dan, eden ar pahpa kahlapo.
Kahnimw pwukat iangahki kisin kahnimw kan me mihte nan sahpw me kohieng sapwen peneinei kan en kadaudok en Dan.
Kaimwiseklahn Kileldi en Sahpw
Ni mehn Israel ko ar kanekehla nehsapw wet, re ahpw kihong sapwen Sosua, nein Nun peliensapw pali.
Duwen me KAUN-O ketin koasoanehdi, re kihong kahnimw me e pekihda: iei Timnad Sera, nan sahpw nahnahn Epraim. Ih eri onehda sapahl kahnimwo oh kousoanla ie.
Samworo Eleasar, Sosua nein Nun, oh kaunen peneinei kan me kadaudok en mehn Israel kan nehkpeseng peliensapw pwukat ni usuhs
pwe re en rapahki kupwur en KAUN-O nan Sailo, ni wenihmwen Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale. Ih met mwomwen ar nehkpeseng sahpwo.
